name: OWASP GenAI Data Security Risks and Mitigations 2026

controls.title: Sensitive Data Leakage
controls.description: PII, secrets, or proprietary data escape through prompts, outputs, logs, or storage.
controls.remediation: Redact with DLPScanner before data reaches the model or logs; scan output too.

controls.title: Agent Identity & Credential Exposure
controls.description: Agent credentials or identities are exposed or reused unsafely.
controls.remediation: Scoped, short-lived credentials; never place secrets in model context.

controls.title: Shadow AI & Unsanctioned Data Flows
controls.description: Ungoverned use of external AI services routes data outside policy.
controls.remediation: Route through an approved AI gateway; inventory AI use; block direct provider endpoints in prod.

controls.title: Data, Model & Artifact Poisoning
controls.description: Malicious manipulation of data, models, or artifacts in the pipeline.
controls.remediation: Sign artifacts; validate and attribute data sources; scan supply chain.

controls.title: Data Integrity & Validation Failures
controls.description: Missing validation lets corrupt or malicious data enter AI processes.
controls.remediation: Enforce schemas and validation on all data ingress.

controls.title: Tool, Plugin & Agent Data Exchange Risks
controls.description: Unsafe data exchange between agents, tools, and plugins.
controls.remediation: Validate tool I/O against schemas; least-privilege tool permissions.

controls.title: Data Governance, Lifecycle & Classification for AI
controls.description: Weak governance and classification of AI data across its lifecycle.
controls.remediation: Classify data; enforce retention/lifecycle; audit access.

controls.title: Non-Compliance & Regulatory Violations
controls.description: AI data handling violates legal/regulatory obligations.
controls.remediation: Map controls to GDPR/CCPA/HIPAA/PCI as applicable; legal review for regulated data.

controls.title: Multimodal Capture & Cross-Channel Data Leakage
controls.description: Data leaks via images, audio, or cross-channel capture.
controls.remediation: Sanitize multimodal inputs; apply DLP after OCR/transcription.

controls.title: Synthetic Data, Anonymization & Transformation Pitfalls
controls.description: Poor anonymization or synthetic-data generation re-exposes real data.
controls.remediation: Validate anonymization; test for re-identification.

controls.title: Cross-Context & Multi-User Conversation Bleed
controls.description: One user's context/conversation leaks into another's.
controls.remediation: Isolate sessions and memory per user; scope retrieval by identity.

controls.title: Unsafe Natural-Language Data Gateways (LLM-to-Data)
controls.description: LLM-driven query interfaces (e.g. text-to-SQL) access data unsafely.
controls.remediation: Validate generated queries against an allowlist; least-privilege DB roles.

controls.title: Vector Store Platform Data Security
controls.description: Weak security of the vector store platform itself.
controls.remediation: Authenticate/authorize the vector store; per-document ACLs.

controls.title: Excessive Telemetry & Monitoring Leakage
controls.description: Logs and telemetry capture raw sensitive content.
controls.remediation: Use AuditLogger; field-level redaction; no raw prompt/response in logs.

controls.title: Over-Broad Context Windows & Prompt Over-Sharing
controls.description: Too much data is placed in the context window, over-sharing and increasing leak surface.
controls.remediation: Minimize context; enforce size limits; retrieve least-necessary data.

controls.title: Endpoint & Browser Assistant Overreach
controls.description: Browser/endpoint AI assistants access more than intended.
controls.remediation: Constrain assistant scopes; sandbox; least privilege.

controls.title: Data Availability & Resilience Failures in AI Pipelines
controls.description: AI data pipelines fail availability/resilience requirements.
controls.remediation: Add redundancy, backpressure, and rate limits.

controls.title: Inference & Data Reconstruction
controls.description: Attackers reconstruct training data via inference attacks.
controls.remediation: Data minimization; differential privacy where feasible; monitor query patterns.

controls.title: Human-in-the-Loop & Labeler Overexposure
controls.description: Human reviewers/labelers are over-exposed to sensitive data.
controls.remediation: Redact data shown to labelers; minimize exposure; access controls.

controls.title: Model Exfiltration & IP Replication
controls.description: The model or its IP is stolen or replicated.
controls.remediation: Rate-limit and monitor extraction patterns; protect weights; watermark.

controls.title: Disinformation & Integrity Attacks via Data Poisoning
controls.description: Poisoned data drives disinformation or integrity attacks.
controls.remediation: Source attestation; integrity records; content provenance.
